name: Hasteröd - Vassbovik
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Hasterod to Vassbovik, mostly on gravel/dirt roads and forest paths through lake-rich forest, wetlands and Bredfjallet; no ferry, rowboat or official alternate geometry found, but current field reports describe a changed/road-walk finish near Vassbovik/Ivarsbosjon

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 11. Hasteröd - Vassbovik
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Hasteröd - Vassbovik.
Official WST slug is 11-hasterod-vassbovik.
Official direction is Hasterod to Vassbovik.
Official distance is 22 km.
Official estimated time is 6-7 h.
Official difficulty is medium / blue-medium.
Surface is gravel/dirt roads and forest paths.
The route starts in Lilla Edet municipality and ends in Uddevalla municipality.

Official narrative describes lake-rich forest, a short steep/strenuous start, wetlands, Store Vaktor, Bredfjallet, Flågfjället, an old cattle lane, Stora Galten, Lindjärns kyrka legend site, a Bronze Age cairn and a final road section with water and arable fields.
Hasterod and Vassbovik are difficult by public transport, and Backamo Flygfalt/Backamo area is suggested as a public-transport approach.
Official start parking is very small, about 2-3 cars, and WST warns not to park along roadsides, on private land or on landowner driveways.
caveats: English WST page is shorter than the Swedish/API text and omits some narrative/current-condition detail.

sources: WST canonical page/API: 22 km, 6-7 h.
Naturkartan: 22.3 km, 7 h.
WST/Naturkartan official geometry computed about 22.276 km.
AllTrails header shows about 15.8 km but recent reviews say the route changed to about 22 km.

sourceContradictions.topic: Route geometry and OSM Hasterod boundary
sources: WST GPX/API and Naturkartan GPX/API start at official Hasterod [58.148133,12.038506].
OSM relation 125010 starts at [58.154627,12.0378336], about 723 m north of official Hasterod.
OSM Stage 10 ends exactly where OSM Stage 11 starts.
sourceContradictions.decision: Use WST/Naturkartan GPX/API as primary. Use OSM only as validation/context north of the OSM boundary unless the boundary mismatch is fixed or the missing official segment is prepended.

sourceContradictions.topic: Current official status versus route-change reports
sources: WST status API returned no active closure/deviation/reroute on 2026-04-29.
Official-page comment and 2024-2025 AllTrails reviews describe a changed route/final road-walk around Vassbovik/Ivarsbosjon.
sourceContradictions.decision: Treat the 22 km WST/Naturkartan official geometry as current canonical route and record the road-walk/clear-cut finish as current route character rather than temporary closure.

sourceContradictions.topic: Store Vaktor fire/grill metadata versus Bredfjallet reserve rules
sources: WST/OSM list Store Vaktor with grill/fireplace metadata.
Bredfjallet reserve rules prohibit fires, and rules lane places Store Vaktor inside Bredfjallet reserve.
sourceContradictions.decision: Import Store Vaktor as shelter, but suppress fire as usable facility or model only as restricted metadata unless a local official sign/manager confirms an exception.

sources: WST lists Store Vaktor shelter and Vargfjallet private/simple overnight option.
WST campsite/rest-place category returned no section result.
Bredfjallet and Bredfjallet ostra reserve rules prohibit camping/tenting.
sourceContradictions.decision: Do not import a formal campsite/tent site for Stage 11; shelter overnight and private Vargfjallet lodging require separate caveats and do not imply tenting permission.

sources: WST lists Vargfjallet water/toilet/shower as private farm support.
OSM-only old spring is not in WST water list.
Route crosses Koperodssjoarna water protection area.
sourceContradictions.decision: Import Vargfjallet as conditional/private check-ahead water; keep old spring pending/treat-filter-verify only; do not mark natural water potable.

sources: WST says Hasterod and Vassbovik are difficult by public transport and suggests Backamo Flygfalt approach.
Transit lane found no current fixed stop named Backamo Airport and no fixed stops at Hasterod/Vassbovik.
Nartrafik addresses Hogen 141 and Vassbo are practical endpoint access.
sourceContradictions.decision: Model Hasterod and Vassbovik as no fixed endpoint bus stops; use Nartrafik/check-ahead as practical access and Gransen/Raane bro/Backa as distant fixed-route alternatives.

lanes.summary: Captured WST canonical facts, GPX/API, Naturkartan, WST places, wet-weather note, access warnings, Store Vaktor/Vargfjallet facilities and Bredfjallet rules.
Compared WST API/GPX, Naturkartan API/GPX and OSM relation 125010; recommended WST/Naturkartan geometry after de-duplication and documented OSM boundary mismatch.
Collected Store Vaktor, Vargfjallet, Hasterod/Vassbovik trailhead records, old spring, off-route shelter/service candidates and no campsite/no direct shop findings.
Captured Hogen Nartrafik, no Hasterod fixed stop, Gransen, Backa/Backamo, Vassbo Nartrafik, Raane bro, Underas, Store Vaktor access and no ferry.
Captured 2024-2025 reports of modern 22 km route/change near Vassbovik/Ivarsbosjon, gravel-road/clear-cut finish, sparse facilities, wetness and stale older obstruction reports.
Captured WST status check, Bredfjallet/Bredfjallet ostra reserves, Bredfjallet Natura 2000, Koperodssjoarna water protection, fire/dog/camping/water rules and hazards.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Stage 11 is strong enough for research-ready normalization with caveats. No targeted follow-up agent batch is needed before continuing to Stage 12; remaining caveats are normal pre-import live-status, signage, transit, protected-area subsegment and facility-clustering QA.

openQuestions: Live-check WST status/deviation widgets, forestry/storm notices, Länsstyrelsen current news and fire-ban/fire-risk status before publication.
Confirm on-site or manager guidance for Store Vaktor grill/fireplace; reserve rules currently mean it must not be modeled as fire allowed.
Verify Vargfjallet current opening/access terms, owner contact expectations and whether water/toilet/shower are reliably available to hikers.
Keep OSM-only old spring pending until field/signage/source verification confirms flow and suitability; do not expose as reliable water.
Run final GIS line-buffer overlay during normalization to assign exact Bredfjallet, Bredfjallet ostra, Natura 2000 and Koperodssjoarna subsegments.
Confirm whether the Vassbovik/Ivarsbosjon road-walk/clear-cut finish has any newer official explanatory notice, and preserve current 22 km geometry over stale short route-app variants.
Verify practical road walking from Raane bro/Underas/Gransen and exact Nartrafik pickup constraints before exposing them as user-facing access recommendations.
Cluster Hasterod and Vassbovik guidepost/info-board OSM records before import, and avoid importing distant Lilla Edet/Ljungskile services as on-route facilities.
